cases.name: gps-only-no-control
cases.desc: A GPS-only board with no control channel. Every CAN capacity figure is zero -- including can_max_payload, which is a capacity like any other -- and a client MUST NOT infer a default.

cases.name: future-minor-unknown-capability
cases.desc: Minor 7 with a capability bit this client has never heard of. A client MUST ignore the unknown bit and use everything it does understand.

cases.name: rate-below-maximum
cases.desc: A device running below its ceiling: 10 Hz of a possible 25, 100 Hz of a possible 833. Current rate and maximum rate are separate fields and a client MUST NOT read one for the other.
cases.note: The only vector where the current and maximum rates differ. Without it a decoder can read gps_rate_hz from gps_max_rate_hz's offset and pass the whole corpus -- found by tools/mutate.py, not by review.

cases.name: short-payload
cases.desc: 23 bytes. Info is fixed-size; a truncated read MUST be rejected.

cases.name: long-payload
cases.desc: 25 bytes. Info has no extension mechanism, so trailing bytes MUST be rejected rather than ignored.
